- 新增「视频收藏」：粘贴 YouTube、B站（支持 BV 号和 b23.tv 短链）或夸克网盘的视频链接，每个视频生成一篇笔记，包含要点、简介原文和「我的笔记」。
  New Video Library: paste a YouTube, Bilibili (BV ids and b23.tv short links work) or Quark Drive video link. Each video becomes a note with key points, the original description and a "My notes" section.
- 有创作者章节的视频会自动生成带时间戳的要点，点时间戳播放器就跳到那个位置；没有章节的视频，自己在笔记里写 [12:30] 也能点。
  Videos with creator chapters get timestamped key points automatically; click a timestamp to jump there. For other videos, write timestamps like [12:30] in your notes and they become clickable too.
- 视频在笔记顶部播放，往下翻会自动缩成小窗，翻回来回到原位；播放框按视频原比例显示，横屏竖屏都不会有多余黑边。
  Videos play at the top of the note and shrink to a mini player when you scroll away, then return when you scroll back. The frame follows each video's own shape, landscape or vertical.
- B站在桌面端用完整播放器，登录后可以直接切换 1080P、倍速和弹幕；夸克网盘视频在线播放，不占本地空间。登录会打开单独的窗口。
  On desktop, Bilibili uses its full player, so after logging in you can switch to 1080P, change speed and toggle danmaku. Quark Drive videos stream online without using local storage. Login opens in its own window.
